verdict.rationale: The pack contains privacy claims: prompts are never tracked or trained on, and local runs never leave the machine. Neither documents a user-facing control for data retention periods or deletion of conversation or prompt data, locally or on Ollama's Cloud. 'ollama rm' removes downloaded models, not user data, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
